idea-plugin.name: Kokedera Icons - Japanese Moss Temple Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Kokedera Icons

A file icon theme inspired by the moss temple garden in Kyoto. Designed to pair with the Kokedera color theme. Every icon draws from the same palette of moss greens, lantern ambers, and stone grays.

  • File & folder icons covering languages, frameworks, configs, DevOps, docs, and media
  • Named folder icons (src, lib, tests, components, api, database, docker, and more)
  • Hundreds of file name & extension mappings — from .rs to .prisma to kustomization.yaml
